snippet.title: I'm on Observation Duty 8 | Announcement Trailer | Coming soon to PC & Consoles
snippet.description:
Use your sharp eyes and keen attention to detail to spot the anomalies... Before the anomalies spot you. I'm on Observation Duty 8 is coming to PC (Windows, MacOS and Linux) and Consoles (PS5 & Xbox Series S/X) soon.

Play the demo and wishlist I'm on Observation Duty 8 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2564960/Im_on_Observation_Duty_8/

Wishlist I'm on Observation Duty 8 on PlayStation:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016799/

Wishlist I'm on Observation Duty 8 on Xbox Series S/X:
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/im-on-observation-duty-8/9nbm4pxhjwww
